name: Going To Your Brother
overview: Scripture instructs believers to pursue reconciliation and forgiveness within the community of faith, emphasizing personal responsibility in addressing offenses. Jesus teaches that when we become aware of a grievance between ourselves and a brother, we should seek to resolve it directly and privately to restore fellowship, as seen in Matthew 18:15. This approach is grounded in a heart of forgiveness, reflecting the Father's forgiveness toward us (Matthew 18:35), and is coupled with a call to avoid judgmental attitudes (Matthew 7:1) and to act honorably toward all (Romans 12:17). Additionally, Galatians 6:1 encourages restoring those caught in sin with gentleness and self-awareness, highlighting the spirit in which correction should be administered.
